CALL {
  WITH currentFile
  OPTIONAL MATCH (componentFile:Component {name: './PriceFilter'})
  RETURN componentFile
}

  CREATE (componentFile:Component {name: './PriceFilter'})
)

WITH 'clipboard.utils.ts' AS fileName,
     CASE 
       WHEN fileName CONTAINS '.service.' THEN 'Service'
       WHEN fileName CONTAINS 'ISitecoreComponent' THEN 'Rendering'  
       WHEN fileName CONTAINS 'store' THEN 'Store'
       ELSE 'Component'
     END AS fileType


MERGE (file:fileType {name: fileName})


WITH file
MERGE (f:Function {name: 'copyToClipboard'})
MERGE (file)-[:EXPORTS]->(f)


WITH file, f
MERGE (c1:Function {name: 'writeText', owner: 'navigator.clipboard'})
MERGE (file)-[:CALLS]->(c1)


RETURN file, f, c1

WITH 'IDestinationsAvailability.ts' AS fileName


MERGE (file:Component {name: fileName}) 
WITH file, fileName
CALL {
    WITH fileName, file
    
    WHERE fileName CONTAINS '.service.'
    SET file:Service
    RETURN file
}
CALL {
    WITH fileName, file
    
    WHERE false 
    SET file:Rendering
    RETURN file
}
CALL {
    WITH fileName, file
    
    WHERE false 
    SET file:Store
    RETURN file
}
WITH file

UNWIND exportedFunctions AS functionName
MERGE (fnc:Function {name: functionName})

UNWIND calledFunctions AS func
MERGE (cf:Function {name: func.name, owner: func.owner})
MERGE (file)-[:CALLS]->(cf)


RETURN file

CREATE (file:Component { name: 'IAvCache.ts' }) 
WITH file
CALL {
    WITH file
    WHERE 'IAvCache.ts' CONTAINS '.service.'
    SET file:Service
    RETURN file
    UNION
    WITH file
    WHERE 'IAvCache.ts' CONTAINS 'ISitecoreComponent' 
    SET file:Rendering
    RETURN file
    UNION
    WITH file
    WHERE 'IAvCache.ts' CONTAINS 'store' 
    SET file:Store
    RETURN file
}
